evidence.title: OmniGet: free yt-dlp GUI for Windows, macOS and Linux

name: OmniGet
summary: Free, open-source yt-dlp GUI desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux: downloads video, audio, torrents and files from 1,000+ sites.
description: A Rust + Tauri desktop app that puts yt-dlp behind one box: paste a link, pick quality and format, and a resumable queue downloads video, audio, image galleries, torrents and direct files from 1,000+ sites, using your own browser session via a Chrome/Firefox extension. Built-in modules add AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Ollama) on a canvas, an MCP server, a music player, video and YouTube clients, book/PDF readers and Telegram.
contains: Rust + Tauri app for Windows 10+, macOS 10.15+ and Linux
runs and updates yt-dlp and FFmpeg; verifies yt-dlp's SHA-256 before running
1,000+ working site families today (per the site's FAQ)
AI coding agents on a canvas; MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex
superpowers: Music, Watch, OmniTube, Read, Telegram, Global Downloader, League of Legends
Chrome and Firefox extension sends the current page with your own session
no telemetry, no account, no ads, no paid plan
site notes the GitHub account is temporarily unavailable; repo links do not open
